access_statement: Paths opened by this pass: (1) the brief at .census-passes/MS/brief.txt (the exact path given in the task message; hashed before inspection, sha256 matched the supplied expected value; copied verbatim to pass-A/brief.received.txt); (2) .census-passes/MS/inputs/: INPUTS.json, manifest.pass.jsonl, schemas/labels.schema.json, schemas/completion.schema.json, schemas/examples/completion.jsonl, schemas/examples/pass-A.jsonl, and originals/<sha256> for all 649 retrieved entries (read-only; never edited, chmod-ed or written through); (3) .census-passes/MS/pass-A/ (own outputs, scripts, renders, temp). Directory listings were taken only of inputs/ and pass-A/. No repo docs/, no git commands or git history files, no ~/yokel-captures, no other pass or state directory, no adapter output, no shared parser candidates, no other agents' /tmp files, no network, no installs, no sub-agents. Exposure disclosure (passive, harness-injected, not opened by this pass): at dispatch the Claude Code harness placed into session context (a) git status for the worktree including five recent commit subject lines, among them 'research(state-coverage): MS census step 3 acquisition (filing-ID sequence 591/592, scans, partial agency cross-checks)', 'WA census step 3 acquisition (2,852 entries; HCA/L&I partial cross-checks)', 'owner step-3 sign-off; CT noi/nod partial coverage; WA outreach', 'sanitized blind-pass input projection (census/pass_inputs.py)' and 'freeze step-4 blind-pass briefs (WA/VA/CT/MS)'; (b) the repo AGENTS.md project overview (mentions the state-coverage pilot, ADR 0013 and docs/plans/state-coverage.md by name only); (c) user-level CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md workflow instructions and an unrelated memory index. None contained MS labels, candidate IDs, counts or findings from any pass; the 591/592 figure was not used. Because the brief defines isolated=true as 'no exposure', isolated is set false and the primary must decide whether this harness-injected context affects validity. The harness also auto-persisted one oversized tool output of this pass (my own read of the inputs/schemas files) under ~/.claude/projects/.../tool-results/; that file was not opened.
tools_used: python3 3.13 run with -I (isolated mode): manifest/original sha256+byte_length verification (scripts/verify_inputs.py), slice parsing (scripts/parse_slices.py), label/completion emission (scripts/emit.py, handlers.py, emit_xchk.py, common.py), local schema+cross-record validator (scripts/validate.py; jsonschema not installed, so a draft-2020-12 subset validator was written and negative-tested)

swiftc + macOS PDFKit: scripts/render (page rasterisation to PNG, max dimension 1700 px for SOS scans, 1400 px for MID pages) and scripts/pdftext (native text extraction for text_pdf entries); module cache and temp kept in pass-A/tmp

Claude Code Read tool as image viewer: every page of all 621 retrieved scan_pdf (text_layer none) entries was rendered and viewed (673 pages; per-entry pages in pages_viewed.json); extraction notes were written to extract.jsonl immediately after viewing each group. The harness later elided many images from the visible transcript ('[media removed: request limit]'); viewing itself occurred.

Deterministic partial-text rule (recorded per brief): render and view every text_failure_locators page plus any page with native text <200 characters or an embedded image object. No retrieved entry has text_layer partial; voluntarily applied to native PDFs: ms-xchk-mid-notice-202510 pp13-14 and ms-xchk-mid-notice-202610 p19 rendered and viewed.
shasum -a 256 for brief and copy; sips/qlmanage not used; no OCR used
